column5: The retained endpoint worker sends exact bucket flags and ordered scan requests, accepts leaderless regions, validates headers, preserves response topology, and falls back nowhere at this transport boundary. Full router streaming, forwarding, request pooling, metrics, tracing, and the remaining PD surface remain external.

The transport-neutral PD model now preserves ordered peers, optional leader, down and pending peers, bucket versions, keys, stats, period, and batch-scan ordering. QueryRegion streaming, router-service selection, and asynchronous routing remain external.

GetRegion, GetRegionByID, ScanRegions, and BatchScanRegions cross the single retained runtime worker and endpoint client map with exact request fields and typed errors. Full request pooling, client-context cancellation, tracing, metrics, and streaming BatchCommands remain external.
